## Checklist
- [ ] No copied code/assets/branding; only original or compatibly-licensed work with attribution
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.p12`, `.mobileprovision`, tokens, `Secrets.swift`)
- [ ] No faked signing / validation / installation — unavailable paths show reason
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`VantaTests/`), all assertions real
- [ ] Docs updated (`README`, `Documentation/`, `CHANGELOG.md` Unreleased)
- [ ] Accessibility considered (Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, contrast, Reduce Motion)
- [ ] CI (build + tests) passes or is tracked
